content: The IpduM module shall be configurable to send a transmission request for the new multiplexed I-PDU to the PDU Router because of the following trigger conditions/modes: • receiving a static part • receiving a dynamic part • receiving a static or a dynamic part 24 of 106 Document ID 182: AUTOSAR_SWS_IPDUMultiplexer Specification of I-PDU Multiplexer AUTOSAR CP R22-11 • does not trigger transmission because of receiving anything of this I-PDU ( Ip- duMTxTriggerMode None) in case of TriggerTransmit For configuration, see [ECUC_IpduM_00052].
